name: delete_profile
title: Delete profile
description: Delete a saved meeting profile from <NARUMI_HOME>/profiles.json. The default profile cannot be deleted — make another profile default first with set_profile (make_default=true). Meetings already created with the profile are unaffected (their config was copied into their manifest). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown profile name), invalid_argument (the profile is the current default), internal.
